info.title: Gemini API
info.description:
Unofficial OpenAPI description of the Gemini API (Google AI Studio / generativelanguage.googleapis.com), written from Google's published API reference at https://ai.google.dev/api and, for the generateContent content types, the googleapis proto definitions. Operations are tagged by AI Studio category.

Not included: Live API and Live Music API (WebSocket), tuned models, corpora and other resources the reference lists without method details.

How to connect in Inline: choose an API key in a header, header name `x-goog-api-key`, and paste a key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Many generation calls spend billable quota.

post.summary: Upload a file (media upload, including resumable session start)
post.description: media.upload. Media upload URI. For resumable uploads send header X-Goog-Upload-Protocol=resumable and X-Goog-Upload-Command=start (plus X-Goog-Upload-Header-Content-Length and X-Goog-Upload-Header-Content-Type) with a JSON body; the session URL is returned in the x-goog-upload-url response header. Then POST the bytes to that URL with X-Goog-Upload-Offset=0 and X-Goog-Upload-Command="upload, finalize"; that final response is a CreateFileResponse (JSON with a file field).

200.description: CreateFileResponse. For the resumable start command the response carries the x-goog-upload-url header.

x-goog-upload-url.description: URL to which the file bytes are uploaded (resumable start only).
